import re

def extract_pairs(text):
    pairs=[]
    for match in re.finditer(r'Demo pair \d+ input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair \d+ output \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)(?=\n\nSame instance\.|\nWrong attempts|\Z)', text, re.S):
        h,w=map(int,match.group(1,2))
        inp=[[int(v) for v in row.split()] for row in match.group(3).splitlines()]
        out=[[int(v) for v in row.split()] for row in match.group(4).splitlines() if row.strip()]
        print('parsed',h,w,len(inp),len(out),set(map(len,inp)),set(map(len,out)))
        pairs.append((inp,out))
    return pairs
pairs=[]
